---
title: "Bonus!" 
---



<div style="margin: 40px auto; width: 600px; text-align:center;">
  <p>🦈   Fish Eaten: <span id="score">0</span>   🦈</p>
  <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="600" height="300" style="border:1px solid #ccc; background-color: #f0f0f0;"></canvas><br/>
  <button onclick="jump()" style="background-color: #f0f0f0;">Swim!</button>
</div>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let dinoY = 250;
let jumping = false;
let obstacleX = canvas.width;
let obstacleY = 70
let score = 0;
let speed = 2;

function drawDinosaur(y) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = "#375a7f"
  ctx.fillRect(100, y - 23, 5, 21);
  ctx.fillRect(105, y - 21, 5, 17);
  ctx.fillRect(110, y - 19, 5, 5);
  ctx.fillRect(110, y - 10, 5, 5);

  // Body
  ctx.fillRect(65, y - 25, 35, 25);
  ctx.fillRect(55, y - 23, 10, 21);
  ctx.fillRect(45, y - 21, 10, 17);
  ctx.fillRect(35, y - 19, 10, 13);

  // Top Fin
  ctx.fillRect(80, y - 30, 10, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(75, y - 35, 10, 15);

  // Bottom Fin 
  ctx.fillRect(70, y - 5, 10, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(70, y + 5, 5, 5);

  // Tail
  ctx.fillRect(30, y - 21, 10, 15);
  ctx.fillRect(25, y - 25, 10, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(25, y - 10, 10, 10);

  // Eye
  ctx.fillStyle = "white"
  ctx.fillRect(95, y - 17, 3, 3);
}

function drawObstacle(x, y) {
  // Main body of cactus
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff879b"
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 3, 5, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y, 16, 18);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 18, y + 2, 5, 14);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 23, y + 4, 5, 10);
  //ctx.fillRect(x - 5, 192, 5, 14);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 27, y + 1, 6, 6);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 27, y + 10, 6, 6);
  
}

function jump() {
  if (jumping) return;
  jumping = true;
  let initialY = dinoY;
  let peak = 190;
  let duration = 1800;
  let start = null;

  function animateJump(timestamp) {
    if (!start) start = timestamp;
    let elapsed = timestamp - start;
    let progress = elapsed / duration;

    if (progress < 0.5) {
      dinoY = initialY - peak * (progress * 2);
    } else if (progress < 1) {
      dinoY = (initialY - peak) + peak * ((progress - 0.5) * 2);
    } else {
      dinoY = initialY;
      jumping = false;
    }
  
    drawScene();

    if (jumping) requestAnimationFrame(animateJump);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(animateJump);
}

function drawScene() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawDinosaur(dinoY);
  drawObstacle(obstacleX, obstacleY);
}

function moveObstacle() {
  obstacleX -= speed;

  if (obstacleX < -10) {
    obstacleX = canvas.width;
    score = 0;
    document.getElementById("score").innerText = score;
    speed = 2; 
    obstacleY = 50 + Math.random() * 160
  }

  // Collision detection
  if (obstacleX < 100 && obstacleX > 40 && (obstacleY >= dinoY - 20 && obstacleY <= dinoY+ 40)) {
    score++;
    document.getElementById("score").innerText = score;
    obstacleX = canvas.width;
    if (score % 5 === 0) speed += 0.5;
    obstacleY = 50 + Math.random() * 160
}

  drawScene();
  requestAnimationFrame(moveObstacle);
}

// Start the game
drawScene();
requestAnimationFrame(moveObstacle);
</script>
